tDCS-induced changes in brain function, as measured by EEG, were related to changes in neurochemicals, as measured by MRS.
tDCS produces reliable and reproducible changes in the human brain, and that these changes are associated with changes in neural oscillations, neurometabolites, and functional connectivity.

the neuroplastic effects of tDCS and how these effects can be tracked across different levels of brain function using multimodal imaging techniques (MRS, fMRI, EEG).
